question: Which candidate judgments reuse endpoints, exact implementation bytes or source files, and what does this prevent us from claiming about independence?
population: All 43 prepared pairs, without selecting by outcome

graphs.endpoint: Cases adjacent if they share a unit ID
graphs.exact_body: Cases adjacent if they share a unit ID or an exact snippet SHA256
graphs.source_file: Cases adjacent if they share a unit ID, exact snippet SHA256, or a pinned source path+source SHA256

closure: Connected components, not just direct pairwise matches; every case retained
measurements: components and sizes under each graph
whether newly added pairs reuse old endpoints or files
checks: transitive bridge, exact-copy and source-file controls
limits: These are mechanical dependence groups, not semantic families or statistically independent units
Different components may share ancestry or algorithms
Source-file grouping is conservative and may overgroup
No automatic held-out split or relevance labels
stop: One complete audit and controls; reuse existing layered evaluator, no new ranking or parameter search
